spec2def(riched20.dll riched20.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

list(APPEND riched20_rc_deps
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/riched_tom.rgs
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/riched_tom.tlb)

add_typelib(riched_tom.idl)

# riched20.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/riched20-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(riched20_shims OBJECT caret.c clipboard.c context.c editor.c list.c paint.c para.c reader.c richole.c row.c run.c string.c style.c table.c txthost.c txtsrv.c undo.c wrap.c writer.c)
target_link_libraries(riched20_shims PRIVATE wine uuid oldnames libole32 liboleaut32 libusp10 libimm32 libuser32 libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(riched20_shims)
add_dependencies(riched20_shims stdole2)
add_cargo_module(riched20 riched20-cargo riched20.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS riched20_shims psdk ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/riched_tom.tlb uuid_sources)
